accuracy_scope: Full ordered prediction-before-update replay; all available predictions. The frozen final30% perworker/store is scored separately after replaying its70% prefix. No arbitrary warmup exclusion. Two-way common support and own support are separate.
model_comparison: Configuration comparison at identical finalcandidate source: default4x4 NNLS eager versus4x1 signed lazy with current full-feature signed fitting; historical subset patches are disabled. This is not a pre-PR source comparison.
hashing: Same fixed-hasher control binary for bothconfigurations. Five actual randomized-production accuracy repeats are separate.

production_randomized_crosscheck.note: Five own-support runs perconfiguration; unpaired reproducibility context.

cpu.timing_scope: Only native prediction-before-update loops; excludes parsing, dispatch preparation, fresh perworker model construction, diagnostics, destruction, serialization.
cpu.weighting: Each original eligible observation counts once; calibrated fresh-pass repetitions do not change case weights.
cpu.order: default,signed on even rounds; signed,default on odd rounds;12rounds
cpu.host_limitations: Local macOS desktop; CPU affinity unavailable. Process CPU excludes descheduling, but frequency/cache effects and contention remain possible.
